title: Charleston County, SC cyberattack, Nov 16, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Charleston County, SLED, any news outlet, government agency, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: This is a county government in South Carolina. The county has not said how many people's information is involved, so size rests on the organization's reach, not a count.
who_is_affected: Possibly people whose information is held in county systems; the county has not said whether personal or financial information was taken. It says day-to-day operations and life safety services are unaffected.

known.text: Charleston County says it identified a sophisticated cyberattack on Nov 16.
The county says its IT team noticed unusual network activity that evening, secured systems overnight and notified SLED.
The county confirms data was copied from its systems.
SLED is treating it as a criminal investigation, with state and federal agencies assisting.
The county says day-to-day operations are unaffected and core life safety services remain intact.

not_known.text: What data was copied, and whether it includes personal or financial information.
How the attackers got into the county's systems.
Whether a ransom was demanded or any data has been published.
Whether it is connected to any other incident this month.
